title: Upwind Raises $300 Million at $3.8 Billion Valuation for AI, Cloud Cybersecurity
summary: Upwind Security, a startup offering cybersecurity for artificial intelligence and cloud applications, is raising fresh financing that values the company at $3.8 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Dell Shares Rise After Boosting Sales Outlook by $25 Billion
summary: Dell Technologies Inc. shares jumped after the company boosted its annual sales forecast by $25 billion in a further sign of surging demand for servers to run artificial intelligence tasks.

title: Nvidia’s Huang Urges G20 to Speed AI Adoption as Key to Growth
summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang called on Group of 20 nations to accelerate their adoption of artificial intelligence as a way to enhance growth, urging the world’s largest economies to expand data centers and other infrastructure to support the emerging technology.

title: ElevenLabs Hires OpenAI VP as First Chief Revenue Officer
summary: ElevenLabs has hired former OpenAI executive Ashley Kramer as its first chief revenue officer, part of the  startup’s efforts to drum up business demand for  its artificial intelligence voice tools.

title: Boehringer Signs Deal for Owkin AI, Joining Astra and Sanofi
summary: Boehringer Ingelheim GmbH agreed to use Owkin’s artificial-intelligence model to help discover new oncology and immunology medicines.

title: OpenAI Faces New Lawsuits Linked to Shooting at Canadian School
summary: OpenAI was hit with multiple lawsuits claiming the artificial intelligence company could have prevented a mass shooting in Canada earlier this year by informing law enforcement about the suspected killer’s messages with the popular chatbot ChatGPT.

title: Deutsche Telekom Names New CFO, CTO in Management Reshuffle
summary: Deutsche Telekom AG has named Dhananjay Mirchandani as its next chief financial officer, part of a number of executive changes at the top of Europe’s biggest telecommunications company.

title: Kingspan Seeks Green Bonds as Data Center Demand Lifts Firm
summary: Kingspan Group Plc has pulled in more than €4.6 billion ($5.3 billion) of investor demand for a green bond sale, as the AI data center buildout has helped the Irish company lift its profit outlook.

title: Tencent-Backed Enflame’s IPO Draws 4,073 Times Retail Demand
summary: The initial public offering of Shanghai Enflame Technology Co., a company backed by Tencent Holdings Ltd., drew strong demand from retail investors, as the last of the so-called “four little dragons” of leading Chinese artificial intelligence chipmakers taps the public market.

title: Uber to Cut 3,300 Jobs in Company Overhaul to Reduce Management Layers
summary: Uber Technologies Inc. is cutting about 3,300 roles, or 10% of its staff globally, in a massive restructuring aimed at reducing management layers and reallocating spending into its ride-sharing, delivery and robotaxi businesses.

title: Micron, SK Hynix Provide Surprise Twist to US Chips Acts Debate
summary: The memory-chip makers were a low priority when the US sought to revive domestic manufacturing

title: Oura Taps Netflix, Robinhood Veterans for Board Ahead of IPO
summary: Oura, the maker of popular smart rings that track health, fitness, and sleep, is expanding its board of directors as it prepares for an initial public offering.The company said Wednesday that it is appointing four new independent directors with public company experience. title: AI Layoffs at Microsoft, Amazon, Meta Drive Seattle Luxury Home Sales Down 15%
summary: Job cuts in the Seattle area are hurting luxury real estate sales

title: AI Fund Chief Urges UK Government to Think Like an Investor to Boost Startups
summary: The head of the UK’s £500 million ($675 million) Sovereign AI Fund urged the government to adopt an investor mindset as ministers seek to spur growth in the domestic industry.

title: Range Rover's First Fully-Electric Model Costs Over $200,000
summary: Jaguar Land Rover's first electric Range Rover will start at £154,070 ($208,420), a price tag that will test wealthy buyers’ appetites for a battery-powered sport utility vehicle. Nigel Blenkinsop, chief operating officer at Jaguar Land Rover, speaks on Bloomberg Television about the new vehicle, the outlook for sales in the US and competition with Chinese automakers. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Homeplus Creditors Accept Korean Mart’s Rehabilitation Plan
summary: Creditors of South Korean megamart Homeplus agreed on Wednesday to accept a rehabilitation plan aimed at keeping the company afloat.

title: TSMC’s Quarterly Chipmaking Tool Needs Almost Doubled This Year
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.’s need for chipmaking tools has nearly doubled since the end of last year as it expands production to meet AI demand, a senior executive said.

title: Lyte Closes $165 Million Round, Bringing AI Startup's Valuation to $1.6 Billion
summary: Lyte, a fast-growing robotics and artificial intelligence startup from top members of Apple Inc.'s Face ID team, has secured about $165 million in a new funding round that more than triples the company’s valuation to $1.6 billion.

title: Softbank-Backed Opay Considers a Secondary Listing in Nigeria
summary: Softbank Group Corp.-backed Opay Digital Services Ltd. is considering a secondary listing in Nigeria after an initial public offering in the US, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

title: Renault-Backed Wandercraft Seeks €100 Million in New Funding
summary: Wandercraft, the French robotics startup backed by Renault SA, is seeking about €100 million ($116 million) in fresh funding to expand its business, people with knowledge of the matter said.
